notes.title: Update Winter 2017
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27162966/3b8cbe540abef522e4d82f4181ea447b7d8ab41b.jpg[/img]
Planned update for winter 2017:

- updated AI of the NPCs
- updated GFX to DX11
- better performance, more fps
- more ammo for some weapons

- free addon DLC with new levels.

:)
